Business Name

Your Brand

A clear, memorable name aligned with the idea.

Business Concept

A focused business concept built around your idea, customer need and launch constraints.

Target Customers

Define your primary customer, their needs, buying behavior and the moment they are most likely to purchase.

Problem & Solution

Identify the painful problem and position your product or service as the simplest practical solution.

Pricing Strategy

Start with a simple entry offer, a core package and an optional premium tier. Validate willingness to pay before scaling.

Startup Cost

Prioritize essential tools, initial inventory or delivery costs, branding and customer acquisition. Keep fixed costs low during validation.

Revenue Model

Revenue can come from direct sales, packages, subscriptions, repeat purchases or service retainers depending on the business model.

Marketing Strategy

  • Choose one primary customer segment.
  • Create short-form educational and problem-solving content.
  • Use direct outreach and referrals to get the first customers.
  • Track leads, conversion and repeat purchases before increasing spend.

30-Day Launch Plan

Week 1 — Validate

Talk to customers, refine the offer and test demand.

Week 2 — Build

Create the minimum viable product or service and basic brand assets.

Weeks 3–4 — Launch

Acquire first customers, collect feedback and improve the offer.
